name: Commons Fridge Functional Prototype v1.4 (English build)
evidenceBoundary: Researcher-tested technical demonstrator; not participant usability validation.
notes: Routes are URL hash fragments resolved in the browser; the server returns the same document for all three. Correct routing must be confirmed on a real phone.
Ownership is stored as stable keys (personal / shared / ask) and plans as stable keys (soon / week / open), so records saved by v1.0, v1.1 and v1.2 migrate automatically.
Plan state is derived from the user's own declared plan, never from an expiry date. The build contains no timer, no notification API and no food-safety inference.
No camera, upload, account, analytics or external runtime dependency.
